import logging

import anthropic

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
MODEL = "claude-haiku-5-5"
RETRYABLE = {429, 500, 503, 529}


async def call(client, request):
    # retry-after is honoured by the caller.
    message = await client.messages.create(model=MODEL, max_tokens=1024, **request)
    if message.stop_reason == "refusal":
        logger.warning("declined")
    return len(message.content)


def build():
    return anthropic.AsyncAnthropic(max_retries=0)
